verdict.rationale: Brex documents issuing both physical and virtual corporate cards, with built-in controls in 60+ countries. Virtual cards can be created instantly or in one click. Spend limits can be set for individuals and departments, and community users praise the dynamic card generator. However, limits are documented at the user, budget, or department level rather than explicitly per card, and nothing shows physical cards are issued to team members within minutes. missing for 10: explicit per-card spend-limit documentation, evidence that physical card issuance takes minutes, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end issue-with-limit workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit
